name: Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (DLT)
sku: Lakeflow pipelines as included in the Databricks platform. Documentation reviewed on the AWS docs site. Formerly Delta Live Tables; the record ID is kept because IDs are immutable.

transform.sql-transform.note: A declarative framework for batch and streaming pipelines written in SQL, built from streaming tables and materialised views.

transform.code-transform.note: The same declarative pipelines can be written in Python, on equal footing with SQL.

transform.stream-processing.note: Pipelines apply incremental batch and streaming transformations through streaming tables.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Pipelines ingest from message buses as well as cloud storage.

bands.note: Expectations are SQL boolean checks on every record flowing through a pipeline, with a choice to warn, drop the record or fail the update.

presentation.tagline: Declarative batch and streaming pipelines with built-in quality checks.
